title: Triangular Sun Shade Sail – UV Protection for Garden & Patio
descriptionHtml:
The sun makes your patio unusable at midday

When the sun is at its highest, the deck, the poolside and the patio get far too hot to stay on. You and the kids are driven indoors, the furniture fades and the barbecue night moves to the shade by the neighbor's hedge. A patio without shade is a patio you hardly use.

Cool shade in a few minutes

Our triangular sun shade sail is stretched over the patio, pool or play area and instantly creates a cool, shaded zone. The UV-protective fabric with a silver coating reflects the sun's heat instead of letting it through – so you can enjoy being outside all day. Rope is included for every corner, so you're up and done in a few minutes.

Features

  • Effective UV protection – the silver coating reflects sunlight and keeps the heat out.
  • Durable outdoor fabric – polyester that handles sun, wind and rain season after season.
  • Strong corners with D-rings – stable mounting that holds even in wind.
  • Rope included – everything you need to set it up right away.
  • Two sizes – 3×3×3 m and 4×4×4 m for different areas.
  • Stylish khaki – suits most gardens and patios.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
